data.heading: Built in Bangladesh. Trusted globally.
data.intro: Tusho is a senior creative professional who solves critical problems through clear, considered creative work. Not someone who decorates problems — someone who resolves them.
body: Operating between Bangladesh and Europe, he leads teams and brands with the same quiet confidence he brings to everything else in his life: a rider, a drummer, a footballer, a builder.
The range runs from brand design and motion to creative direction and program management. Authority demonstrated through case studies, not stated in bios.
Lately: building tusho.space, directing a slate of motion-led brand projects, and documenting the craft along the way.
